name: Local Services Comparison
description: Compare providers for a required local service using the active mode's configured location. Use for requests such as compare AC repair, plumbing, electrical, cleaning, or other supported service providers. Combines Google Local Services screening and provider signals, broader Google Local business details, and a bounded Yelp search with review excerpts for one selected result, then saves optional Stash evidence and creates a dated Canvas shortlist. It does not crawl websites, contact providers, request quotes, or book service.

steps.abort_speech: Local services comparison requires a supported service after the command, for example /local_services_compare AC repair.
steps.description: Find Google Local Services providers and screening signals using the active mode location
Gather broader Google Local listings, addresses, hours, and business links
Gather Yelp provider signals and up to three excerpts for the most-reviewed returned Yelp result

params.name: local_services_compare_${filename_timestamp}.txt

steps.description: Optionally save the bounded provider evidence to Stash
Create the dated Canvas provider comparison

success_speech: The local services comparison for ${service} is ready in Canvas.
abort_speech: The local services comparison could not be completed for ${topic}.
